meta.name: pr-to-video
meta.description: Turn a GitHub pull request (a PR URL, owner/repo#N, or 'this PR' in a checked-out repo) into a code-change explainer video — changelog, feature reveal, fix, or refactor walkthrough built from the diff, commits, and files: the input is a code change, not a website. Not a product promo (/product-launch-video) or a no-PR topic explainer (/faceless-explainer). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把代码改动变成讲解视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常需要向团队讲解代码改动
copy.tagline_en: Turn code changes into an explainer video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to explain code changes to others

howto.what: 把一个 GitHub PR 变成讲解代码改动的视频。Claude 会读取 PR 的代码变更、提交和文件资料,配上旁白与画面,生成一段成片;可做成改动日志、新功能、修复或重构等主题的讲解。
howto.when: 当你说出一个 GitHub PR(链接、owner/repo#N,或在本地已检出仓库里说“这个 PR”),并要求把它做成代码讲解视频时触发。产品宣传、没有实际 PR 的主题讲解不会走这里。

say.text: 把 owner/repo#123 做成讲解这个代码改动的视频。
say.note: Claude 会读取该 PR 并进入视频制作流程。

say.text: 用这个 PR 做一条新功能上线讲解。
say.note: 会按新功能的角度来安排旁白和画面。

say.text: 给 owner/repo#456 做修复说明视频。
say.note: 会以这次修复为主线来规划整个视频。

howto.what_en: Turns a GitHub PR into a code-change explainer video. Claude parses the PR's diff, commits and files, writes narration and visuals, then renders a finished clip — as a changelog, feature reveal, fix, or refactor walkthrough.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you name a GitHub PR (URL, owner/repo#N, or “this PR” in a checked-out repo) and ask to turn it into a code-change explainer video. Product promos or topic explainers without a real PR are not handled.

say_en.text: Turn owner/repo#123 into a video explaining this code change.
say_en.note: Claude reads the PR and starts the video pipeline.

say_en.text: Use this PR to make a feature-reveal explainer.
say_en.note: It will frame narration and visuals around the new feature.

say_en.text: Make a fix explainer for owner/repo#456.
say_en.note: It will center the whole video on this fix.
